component.name: 2ine
component.summary: Give your OS/2 applications a home on GNOME

description.p: Install and run OS/2 applications in a ball of 2ine. Each ball keeps its own drives, runtime settings, CONFIG.SYS, profiles, registry and installed files.
Map your original installation media, save application launchers and follow application output in a native GNOME interface.
Native settings navigation, adaptive registry, searchable application launchers and application preferences, with OS/2 media recovery and shared runtime controls.
